entities.summary: John Warren Bergman is an American politician and retired United States Marine Corps lieutenant general serving as the U.S. representative from Michigan's 1st congressional district since 2017. He is a member of the Republican Party. Jack Bergman was a military leaders & commanders from Shakopee (b. 1947-02-02, Shakopee). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to geopolitics.
